security_audit.summary: All 29 static alerts are benign uses of shell syntax, local configuration files, Markdown formatting, or documentation links. The scripts still introduce a medium supply-chain risk by installing unpinned packages and changing global package-manager state.

remediation.issue: The initializer installs pnpm globally when it is unavailable.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, or stop with installation instructions instead of changing global package-manager state.

remediation.issue: Project and bundling dependencies are installed without complete version pins.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, include a reviewed lockfile, and use frozen dependency installation where practical.

content.value_statement: Complex interactive artifacts often need more structure than a single HTML file. This skill scaffolds React projects and bundles them into shareable HTML.
actual_capabilities: Scaffolds a React and TypeScript project with Vite.
Configures Tailwind CSS, theming variables, and animation support.
Installs reusable shadcn/ui and Radix UI components.
Adds source path aliases to TypeScript and Vite configuration.
Bundles JavaScript, CSS, and dependencies into one HTML file.
Selects a compatible Vite version for Node 18 or newer.
limitations: Requires Bash, Node 18 or newer, package-manager access, and a network connection.
Installs many dependencies and may change global package-manager state.
Targets complex React artifacts rather than simple single-file pages.
Generated artifacts still require functional, accessibility, and browser testing.

use_cases.title: Prototype an Interactive Dashboard
use_cases.description: Create a stateful dashboard with filters, dialogs, tables, and responsive layouts, then share it as one HTML file.

use_cases.title: Present a Product Workflow

use_cases.title: Deliver a Complex AI Artifact
use_cases.description: Turn a detailed interface request into a structured React project and a portable conversation artifact.

output_examples.input: Create an inventory explorer with search, filters, and item details.
output: A searchable inventory table with category and availability filters.
Responsive item detail panels and useful empty states.

best_practices: Use the skill for interfaces that need state, reusable components, or multiple views.
Review generated dependencies and run the scripts in an isolated project directory.
Test keyboard access, responsive layouts, empty states, and the final HTML bundle.
anti_patterns: Do not use the full scaffold for a small static page.
Do not run initialization inside a directory containing valuable project files.
Do not publish the bundle before checking behavior, accessibility, and external asset loading.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React and TypeScript project, configures interface libraries, and bundles the result into one HTML file.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: You need Bash, Node 18 or newer, and access to npm-compatible package registries.

faq.question: Does the final artifact need a server?
faq.answer: The bundling script produces a self-contained HTML file intended for direct sharing and viewing.

faq.question: Is this suitable for simple HTML pages?
faq.answer: No. A direct single-file implementation is usually better for small static pages without complex state.

faq.question: Does the skill test the artifact automatically?
faq.answer: No. Testing is optional in the workflow, so you should verify interactions, accessibility, and responsive behavior before release.
